text:
morgan: Quick shoutout to @felix (ops) and @dina (people-ops) for coordinating the surprise thank-you notes and the 'morning pastries' drop. made the whole team start Monday on a high note. :sunrise: :croissant:
felix: team effort! logistics were a little chaotic but everyone pitched in to label and spread the love. special props to @harper for the handwritten notes. :memo: :handshake:
dina: love seeing cross-team cheer. also snagged a few extra pastries for the remote crew boxes. will post tracking in #shipping. :package: :globe_with_meridians:
harper: handwriting therapy is my happy place. left tiny notes that say "you rock" on a few desks. if you found one, drop a selfie with it! :sparkles: :camera:
coffee-bot: coffee_pour: "Free pour for kudos recipients" initiated by felix at 08:12. enjoy! :coffee:
sam: also shoutout to @katie who stayed late to debug the SSO flake last week so the demos could run smoothly. watching people help across teams makes my morning. :clap: :key:
katie: thanks! fixed a lingering token refresh bug. happy to trade debugging stories for a pastry. :smile:
morgan: dropping this here so leadership sees it during the standup. small kindnesses + quick fixes = huge morale. if you got a note or a pastry, react with an emoji and tag one person you want to high-five. :raised_hands: :tada:
